readme: The RWAlly team owns and holds the private key for every address in `addresses` below. Each one is a persona wallet (Decisions/Seed agent personas 2026-09-23.md) that deposits, votes and exits only through the owner's own Sign queue -- no session holding a persona ever reads a key. Every UI surface that shows one of these addresses labels it as seeded, and no member count or governance claim on this list of addresses is presented as organic demand. This file ships with an empty list; entries are appended only once the owner has actually created and funded a wallet, never in advance of it.
